posts.caption: I was so incredibly happy to find these photos. A while back, I watched a Jschlatt video, he featured a lot of old childhood footage of him and his brother getting their first consoles. These clips just captured the magic of that era so perfectly. It honestly made me a bit sad, wondering if I had any real documentation of those kinds of moments I hold so close to me, or if they were just bound to become fading memories; maybe they still are anyways.. But finding these brought me so much relief, and a whole new level of appreciation for my Dad. I already cherished this memory just because he took the time out of his day to bring me to something I was really excited about; A silly promo event for a console that ended up being the biggest joke of the century (I still love mine, modded to perfection 🤌). But looking back at these, I realized he wasn't just standing there waiting for it to be over, he was really seeing me, and taking the time to hold on to that moment for the both of us. I love my Dad, hes the best. #nostalgia #wiiu #nintendo #memories #toronto

#scrawlvember prompt: BLOOD
Originally, I planned to sketch the Adventure Time blood demon sword, but it just didn’t resonate with me during the drawing process. When blood came to mind, I envisioned crude drawings, distressed tearing, and a chaotic blood splatter. Elements that reminded me of Fight Club. I wanted my rough tracing to symbolize the narrator’s unreliable storytelling; Existing only when convenient to further these new sworn duties brought on by Tyler Durden, with violence and blood similarly used as the common thread.

posts.caption:
Today’s #scrawlvember prompt, FOLD. 

Do you ever think about how careless you are with inanimate objects? I do. Specifically our pizza boxes, so I bring awareness to the poor fellas. Getting folded on the daily has to be tiring. A box covered in sauce and the peppers your relative asked for but ended up not wanting?! The disrespect to the poor thing that holds the delicacy that will make all your problems go away yet you can’t even take the time to scrape out the bits, give ‘‘em to your pups, eat ‘em yourself, DO ANYTHING BUT LEAVE A MESS IN THAT BOX. Let it rest in peace in that dark blue torture chamber you call a recycling box and at the very least, honour your pizza box. Thank you.

IN THE TAPESTRY OF MY LIFE, I YEARNED FOR CLARITY,
TO DISCERN THE FATES OF THOSE INTERTWINED WITH ME,
BUT NOW, A PECULIAR TURN HAS TAKEN HOLD,
WHERE CONTENTMENT IN SOLITUDE UNFOLDS.

OH, HOW IRONIC THE DESIRES I ONCE PURSUED,
NOW REPLACED BY TRANQUILITY, AN ATTITUDE IMBUED,

IN THE SERENITY FOUND IN A SINGLE THOUGHT.

IN LIFE’S GRAND DESIGN, I STAND APART,
ABSORBING THE ESSENCE OF A SOLITARY HEART,
DISCOVERING THE DEPTHS OF MY OWN BEING,
IN THE QUIET WHISPERS OF EXISTENCE’S FREEING.

I've never spoken any of my poems out loud. I wanted this recorded in the moment I finally felt ready to speak my mind out loud, then and there. I've bottled up emotions over and over and I'm at a point where I feel comfortable to express and explore my feelings to the world in hopes that others can learn from me and as can I with their experiences..poems are a really fun and cathartic way to do that.
